Market share percentages for individual vendors (ABBYY ~22%, UiPath ~18%, etc.) — analyst estimates derived from funding, ARR signals, and customer counts; no single authoritative market share study publishes these figures
data_quality_notes: Market size varies significantly across research firms ($3.9B to $14.16B for 2026) due to different definitions of the IDP addressable market — some include adjacent workflow automation revenue. The report uses Grand View Research's $3.9B figure as the conservative baseline and Precedence Research's $1.04B 2021 figure for the 5Y growth calculation. All funding figures are from verified CB Insights / Sacra / company press releases. Gartner Magic Quadrant vendor positions are confirmed via multiple vendor announcements citing the same September 3, 2025 publication date.
